grouping.description: Positive pages map to corpus.metadata.doc_id. Queries touching the same source document are connected transitively across multi-document positives.
grouping.resampling_assumption: Identified source components are treated as exchangeable resampling units; unrecorded cross-component dependencies may remain.

limitations: Laya sees query and source page text only, including for image-based retrieval.
The observed loss does not identify its cause or establish performance on other datasets.
Per-input token telemetry is unavailable; missing diagnostics are not measured zero truncation.
Method ranges are descriptive minima/maxima, not confidence intervals or independent datasets.
